senses.gloss:
जुष् 1. जुष्, cl. 6. A. (ep. also P.) जुषते,
-ति, जुजुषे, जोषिष्यते, अजोषिष्ट, जो-
षितुम्, to be pleased or satisfied, to be propitiated
or propitious; to be favourable; to like, be fond of,
to have pleasure in, delight in (with acc. or gen.);
to enjoy; to show one's self favourable towards
(with acc.); to have pleasure in granting (with loc. of
the person); to devote one's self to, practise, undergo,
suffer; to delight in visiting, frequent, visit, inhabit,
enter; happen to; to have pleasure in performing
(with dat., e. g. जुषते कर्मणे, he likes to engage
in any act); to choose; to give pleasure to (with loc.
of the person): Caus. जोषयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to
like, be fond of, love, behave kindly towards (with
acc.); fondle, cherish; to delight in, approve of,
choose: Desid. जुजुषिषते or जुजोषिषते: Intens.
जोजुष्यते, जोजोष्टि; [cf. Zend zaosha, ‘will, de-
sire;’ Hib. gus, ‘a desire, inclination;’ Goth. kus, ‘to
choose,’ kiusu, kaus, kusum; Germ. kiese; Lat.
gus-tus; Gr. γεύω, γεύομαι.]

2. जुष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, liking, fond of, devoted to (with
acc.); visiting, approaching; [cf. स-जुष्.]

जुष् 3. जुष्, cl. 1. 10. P. जोषति, जोष-
यति, &c., to reason, think, conceive, ima-
gine, investigate, examine; to injure, hurt, kill.

जूष् जूष् (a various reading for यूष्), cl.
1. P. जूषति, &c., to kill, hurt.

जुषाण, अस्, m., N. of a sacrificial formula con-
taining the word जुषाण, pres. part. of rt. 1. जुष्.

जूषण, अम्, n. the plant Grislea Tomentosa,
commonly Dhäiphula.

जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, gratified, pleased, propitiated,
propitious, favourable; liked, wished, loved, agreeable,
[]
usual; frequented, visited; served, obliged, worshipped,
gratified by service; practised; furnished with, pos-
sessed of; (अम्), n. the crumbs or remnants of a
meal or its leavings.
जुष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. love, service, favour, satisfaction.
जुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be served or worshipped.

जुष्क जुष्क, अस्, m., N. of one of the three
Turuṣka kings in Kaśmīra.
—जुष्क-पुर, अम्,
n., N. of a town founded by Jushka.

जुष्कक जुष्कक, अस्, m. = यूष, the water
of boiled pulse, pease-soup, porridge, &c.

जूष, अम्, n. the water of boiled pulse, pease-
soup, porridge, &c.
